question: Let $\vec{a}=\hat{i}+2\hat{j}-\hat{k}$ and $\vec{b}=2\hat{i}-\hat{j}+3\hat{k}$.(a) Evaluate $\vec{a}\times\vec{b}$.(b) Verify that the obtained vector is perpendicular to both $\vec{a}$ and $\vec{b}$.(c) Hence determine the areas of the parallelogram and the triangle having $\vec{a}$ and $\vec{b}$ as adjacent sides.
explanation: (a)Using the determinant form of the vector product,\\vec{a}\\times\\vec{b}=\\begin{vmatrix}\\hat{i} & \\hat{j} & \\hat{k}\\\\1 & 2 & -1\\\\2 & -1 & 3\\end{vmatrix}Expanding along the first row,`\vec{a}\times\vec{b}=\hat{i}[2(3)-(-1)(-1)]-\hat{j}[1(3)-(-1)(2)]+\hat{k}[1(-1)-2(2)]\vec{a}\times\vec{b}=5\hat{i}-5\hat{j}-5\hat{k}`(b)To check perpendicularity with $\vec{a}$,`\vec{a}\cdot(\vec{a}\times\vec{b})=(1)(5)+(2)(-5)+(-1)(-5)=5-10+5=0`Therefore, $\vec{a}\times\vec{b}$ is perpendicular to $\vec{a}$.To check perpendicularity with $\vec{b}$,`\vec{b}\cdot(\vec{a}\times\vec{b})=(2)(5)+(-1)(-5)+(3)(-5)=10+5-15=0`Therefore, $\vec{a}\times\vec{b}$ is also perpendicular to $\vec{b}$.(c)The area of the parallelogram is`|\vec{a}\times\vec{b}|=\sqrt{5^2+(-5)^2+(-5)^2}=5\sqrt{3}`The area of the triangle is one-half of the area of the parallelogram.`\text{Area of triangle}=\frac{1}{2}|\vec{a}\times\vec{b}|=\frac{5\sqrt{3}}{2}`Final ResultThe area of the parallelogram is $5\sqrt{3}$ square units, and the area of the triangle is $\frac{5\sqrt{3}}{2}$ square units.

options.A:
(a) $\vec{a}\times\vec{b}=5\hat{i}-5\hat{j}-5\hat{k}$
(b) Its scalar product with each of $\vec{a}$ and $\vec{b}$ is $0$.
(c) Parallelogram area $=5\sqrt{3}$ and triangle area $=\frac{5\sqrt{3}}{2}$.
options.B:
(a) $\vec{a}\times\vec{b}=-5\hat{i}+5\hat{j}+5\hat{k}$
(b) It is perpendicular to both vectors.
(c) Parallelogram area $=5\sqrt{3}$ and triangle area $=5\sqrt{3}$.
options.C:
(a) $\vec{a}\times\vec{b}=5\hat{i}+5\hat{j}-5\hat{k}$
(b) It is perpendicular only to $\vec{a}$.
(c) Both areas equal $5\sqrt{3}$.
options.D:
(a) $\vec{a}\times\vec{b}=5\hat{i}-5\hat{j}-5\hat{k}$
(b) It is parallel to both vectors.
(c) Parallelogram area $=\frac{5\sqrt{3}}{2}$ and triangle area $=5\sqrt{3}$.
